rationales.quote: The retailer is not going to seven integrations for one hour shipping. They're not going to do a separate integration for Uber, Postmates. They want one...
rationales.explanation: Charles identifies a single integration as a valuable product attribute because retailers do not want to manage multiple delivery integrations.

rationales.quote: I think redundancy is valuable for retailers.
rationales.explanation: Charles views delivery-network redundancy and fallback options as important product value for retailers.

rationales.quote: I have a bunch of investments in and around shipping that I need to make sure are totally de-conflicted
rationales.explanation: Charles conditions his investment on confirming that Shipsi does not conflict with his existing shipping investments.

rationales.quote: having one single API for this stuff, it becomes way more valuable over time because logistics just gets more complex
rationales.explanation: Charles believes a unified logistics API gains strategic value as the delivery ecosystem becomes more complex.

rationales.quote: these digitally native vertical brands that are doing things, tennis shoes, apparel, that are in New York City
rationales.explanation: Charles points to digitally native brands in major cities that are heavily dependent on shipping as a promising initial customer segment.

rationales.quote: I think you're going to end up relaxing this one hour thing.
rationales.explanation: Charles assesses that the company's strict one-hour delivery positioning will likely need to broaden.

rationales.quote: I think same day is a big deal.
rationales.explanation: Charles believes same-day delivery addresses a meaningful customer need, even if one-hour delivery is too narrow.

rationales.quote: I think I’m in. But I need to just make sure I’m de-conflicted.
rationales.explanation: Charles explicitly makes his investment contingent on resolving potential conflicts with existing portfolio companies.

merely any question. decision_link supports_in/out ONLY if the target links the rationale to the commitment/refusal.

turn index exactly once, even when it contains no rationale. An empty rationale list is valid if none was expressed.
